name: Dr. Zakir Hussain Parray
qualifications: Ph.D. (Anaesthesia & Trauma), M.Sc. (Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology), B.Sc. OTT, DOTT, NEP-2020, DSA
position: Head of Department, Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology
bio:
Dr. Zakir Hussain Parray is the Managing Director of ResearchMed Connect and Head of the Department of Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology. He holds a Ph.D. in Anaesthesia & Trauma and an M.Sc. in Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology.

Alongside teaching, he guides allied health students and professionals through research and publication, and his team has published in Scopus-indexed and Elsevier journals. ResearchMed Connect brings this experience to anyone who wants to learn research and publish ethically.
highlights:

message: “Learn continuously, lead responsibly, and create an impact that extends beyond the classroom.”
